text: {"lessons":["I will define a clear thesis and risk limit before each trade, and reassess the thesis—not react to losses or my average cost.","My repeated selling and later buying back at higher prices shows that I need stronger evidence before changing positions and should account for trading decisions across the whole portfolio.","I will avoid adding to declining positions just because prices look lower; I’ll preserve cash, size positions carefully, and judge my choices by long-run results against the market."]}
